about_the_game:
Cartel State is a tactical first-person shooter set in the brutal conflict between the DSA (Drug Squad Agency) and the Cartel. Every round is a test of precision, teamwork, and nerve — one wrong move, and the streets decide who survives.

Built around realism and mastery, Cartel State features repeatable recoil and spray patterns, economy-based loadouts, and team-driven objectives that demand strategy as much as aim. Each firefight rewards control and communication — not luck.

Breach fortified cartel hideouts, storm jungle compounds, and fight through dense favela streets where every corner hides danger. Environments range from cramped interiors to open-air shootouts, each demanding a different tactical rhythm.

Customize your operators with unique masks, tattoos, and gear. Build your perfect weapon setups with optics, suppressors, and attachments that reflect your playstyle — then take them into ranked or casual combat.

No respawns. No hand-holding. Just calculated violence, skill-based gunplay, and the chaos of close-quarters combat.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of realistic violence and blood. Players engage in tactical combat using firearms and explosives, resulting in combat injuries and death. The setting involves criminal organizations, raids, and law-enforcement operations. There are no depictions of torture, sexual content, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 590 (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Designed for online tactical FPS gameplay; performance settings available for lower-end hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Cartel State is a competitive, team-based tactical FPS featuring economy-driven loadouts, operator and weapon customization, and high-skill gunplay. Breach cartel hideouts and fight for control through precision, coordination, and nerve.
